metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire detections than Thailand between August 2016 and February 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System) - MODIS active fire product - Dataset: "FIRMS" or MOD14A1/MYD14A1 (MODIS thermal anomalies/fire) - Better option: Use "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" and "MODIS/006/MYD14A1" or the combined FIRMS dataset - Actually, GEE has "FIRMS" as ee.FeatureCollection, but better to use MODIS fire products - Best: Use "MODIS/006/MCD14DL" (MODIS Combined Terra+Aqua Fire Daily) or MOD14A1/MYD14A1 - Date: August 2016 to February 2018 ('2016-08-01' to '2018-02-28') - Location: Cambodia vs Thailand boundaries 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for fire detection - Fire products have confidence levels - should filter for high confidence fires - Use FireMask band or confidence band to filter valid fire detections 3. Logic: - Count total fire detections in Cambodia vs Thailand - Valid Zero (B): Thailand has more fires than Cambodia - Answer A: Cambodia has more fires - C1: No data available for the period - C2: After filtering, no valid fire pixels - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions cambodia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[102.3, 10.4], [107.6, 10.4], [107.6, 14.7], [102.3, 14.7], [102.3, 10.4]] ]) thailand = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[97.3, 5.6], [105.6, 5.6], [105.6, 20.5], [97.3, 20.5], [97.3, 5.6]] ]) start_date = '2016-08-01' end_date = '2018-03-01' # 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Active Fire Product # Using MOD14A1 (Terra) and MYD14A1 (Aqua) for active fire detections mod14 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1').filterDate(start_date, end_date) myd14 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD14A1').filterDate(start_date, end_date) # Combine Terra and Aqua fire_col = mod14.merge(myd14) print(f"Total fire images: {fire_col.size().getInfo()}") if fire_col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No fire data available for the period.") print("C1") else: # 3. Process fire detections - FireMask band (7=low, 8=nominal, 9=high confidence) # Filter for nominal and high confidence fires (>=8) def mask_fires(image): fire_mask = image.select('FireMask').gte(8) return image.updateMask(fire_mask) fire_col_masked = fire_col.map(mask_fires) # Sum all fire detections over the period fire_sum = fire_col_masked.select('FireMask').sum() # 4. Count fire detections for each country cambodia_stats = fire_sum.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=cambodia, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ) thailand_stats = fire_sum.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=thailand, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ) cambodia_fires = cambodia_stats.get('FireMask').getInfo() thailand_fires = thailand_stats.get('FireMask').getInfo() print(f"Cambodia fire detections: {cambodia_fires}") print(f"Thailand fire detections: {thailand_fires}") # 5. Validation & Final Answer if cambodia_fires is None or thailand_fires is None: print("Calculation failed - invalid result.") print("C3") elif cambodia_fires == 0 and thailand_fires == 0: print("No valid fire pixels after filtering.") print("C2") elif cambodia_fires > thailand_fires: print("Cambodia had more active fire detections.") print("A") else: print("Thailand had more active fire detections.") print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
cambodia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[102.3, 10.4], [107.6, 10.4], [107.6, 14.7], [102.3, 14.7], [102.3, 10.4]]
])

thailand = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[97.3, 5.6], [105.6, 5.6], [105.6, 20.5], [97.3, 20.5], [97.3, 5.6]]
])

start_date = '2016-08-01'
end_date = '2018-03-01'

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Active Fire Product
# Using MOD14A1 (Terra) and MYD14A1 (Aqua) for active fire detections
mod14 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1').filterDate(start_date, end_date)
myd14 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD14A1').filterDate(start_date, end_date)

# Combine Terra and Aqua
fire_col = mod14.merge(myd14)

print(f"Total fire images: {fire_col.size().getInfo()}")

if fire_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No fire data available for the period.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Process fire detections - FireMask band (7=low, 8=nominal, 9=high confidence)
    # Filter for nominal and high confidence fires (>=8)
    def mask_fires(image):
        fire_mask = image.select('FireMask').gte(8)
        return image.updateMask(fire_mask)
    
    fire_col_masked = fire_col.map(mask_fires)
    
    # Sum all fire detections over the period
    fire_sum = fire_col_masked.select('FireMask').sum()
    
    # 4. Count fire detections for each country
    cambodia_stats = fire_sum.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=cambodia,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    thailand_stats = fire_sum.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=thailand,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    cambodia_fires = cambodia_stats.get('FireMask').getInfo()
    thailand_fires = thailand_stats.get('FireMask').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Cambodia fire detections: {cambodia_fires}")
    print(f"Thailand fire detections: {thailand_fires}")
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if cambodia_fires is None or thailand_fires is None:
        print("Calculation failed - invalid result.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif cambodia_fires == 0 and thailand_fires == 0:
        print("No valid fire pixels after filtering.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif cambodia_fires > thailand_fires:
        print("Cambodia had more active fire detections.")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("Thailand had more active fire detections.")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
